items.text: David Montgomery downgraded to out with groin injury.
items.implication: HOU RB committee shifts; more work to other backs.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for HOU RBs behind him.

items.text: FINAL UPDATE: Ashton Jeanty will play; Terry McLaurin will play. Projections updated.
items.why: ETR final confirmation after GTD; Rapoport 'is a go' for Jeanty, Schefter actives list.
items.implication: Jeanty expected but possible limited workload on foot/ankle; McLaurin returns to WAS WR1 role with Daniels back.
items.opportunity: Jeanty lead back if full go; McLaurin routes/targets with Daniels.

items.text: Justin Jefferson is active vs Saints; Jordan Addison and Odell Beckham Jr. inactive.
items.why: Jefferson cleared pregame; Addison ruled inactive.
items.implication: Jefferson full or near-full role in homecoming; Addison out removes secondary target.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share and red-zone for Jefferson with Addison out.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins will play. FINAL UPDATES confirm both Bengals WRs active after questionable tags.
items.why: ETR final updates and Schefter confirmation both cleared to play vs Dolphins.
items.implication: Full CIN WR corps available; no major boost to backups.
items.opportunity: Standard high-volume roles expected for both.

items.text: Sunday AM summary: NOT EXPECTED Ladd McConkey, Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Marvin Harrison; GTD Jefferson/Addison/Jeanty/McLaurin/DJ Moore; EXPECTED Flowers, Kamara etc. Messiest injury week.
items.why: Comprehensive weekend reports compilation; later updated live.
items.implication: Key monitoring list for inactives window; projections live.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries monitored for outs (Warren, Wilson etc).

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. inactive for Sunday vs Lions as Cardinals finalize trade details.
items.why: Team informed him inactive while trade finalized; ETR listed not expected.
items.implication: Full removal from ARI offense vs DET; elevates remaining WRs significantly.
items.opportunity: Major target/route bump for Michael Wilson and others.

items.implication: WAS offense full strength with McLaurin also active; boosts pass catchers.
items.opportunity: Dual-threat QB usage returns; elevates WAS skill players.

items.text: Coaching staffs refuse workhorse on Jaylen Warren including split with Dowdle pre-injury. Passes every test, advanced stats, eye test. Austin Ekeler-esque. Dowdle out elevates fully.
items.why: Usage data and film; Dowdle unlikely/out removes split.
items.opportunity: High snap share, third-down, possible goal-line with Dowdle out.

items.text: George Kittle has illness but expected to play, then officially active vs Seahawks.
Ladd McConkey is active but not expected to play meaningful snaps.
items.why: Active designation but Schefter notes no meaningful snaps expected after foot injury/no practice.
items.implication: Minimal fantasy impact; avoid starting. Opens snaps for other LAC WRs.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Quentin Johnston or others if limited.

items.text: Caleb Williams officially inactive but has a chance to play next week.
items.implication: Bears QB situation shifts; backup starts, impacts CHI pass catchers volume.
items.opportunity: Possible change in scheme/usage for CHI WRs/RBs.

items.text: Zay Flowers expected to play vs Falcons despite questionable foot injury.
items.implication: BAL WR1 role intact with Lamar out (Huntley).

items.text: Rico Dowdle unlikely to play vs Colts due to toe; final determination in warmups. ETR not expected.
items.why: Toe injury; Schefter unlikely, ETR not expected.
items.implication: PIT RB workhorse opportunity opens fully for Jaylen Warren.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr has 5 catches in 4 games. He wasn't a real factor in any Michael Wilson stuff. Kia Kendrick Bourne szn with MHJ inactive/trade.
items.why: MHJ low production data; inactive elevates Wilson/Bourne.
items.implication: Wilson becomes primary ARI WR target vs DET.
items.opportunity: Wilson routes/targets/red-zone expand significantly without MHJ.

items.text: Love Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10 with MHJ inactive.
items.why: MHJ out creates volume; target hog potential.

items.text: Likes Chase Brown a lot this week; 'Brown Gobbler' nickname for target/fantasy gobbling. RB love.
items.why: Targets and points gobbling; strong week projection.
items.opportunity: High snap/target share in CIN offense.

items.text: Love Nico Collins vs TEN as WR8. Target-hog in strong matchup.
items.why: Volume including red-zone vs weak TEN defense.

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison @ NO (WR41); tough matchup/thin role. Confirmed inactive anyway.
items.why: Matchup and usage concerns; later inactive.
